classification: CPU-only isolated verifier-cache control; not a mining, full-node, or network benchmark
notes: The adapter has a bounded, mutex-protected, one-epoch cache. Cached results are a local microbenchmark with only five iterations and a serialised cache lock, not a prediction of final Core-Geth validation throughput. The context-rebuild figures are intentionally conservative. No GPU, miner, block propagation, AVR workload, or energy measurement was performed.
